finding.scope: (g,n)=(6,6) over C with Q-coefficients; S a reduced separated finite-type C-scheme atlas of Hbar^bal carrying the (CE)+(N)+(BAL) family; j=8, i.e. Gr^W_16 H_c^16.
finding.statement: The constant-coefficient corner Gr^W_16 H_c^16(S;Q) of a scheme atlas S of the balanced tetragonal stack Hbar^bal is not an invariant of Hbar^bal: it is atlas-dependent and can be forced to be non-Tate on any atlas by adjoining a suitable finite-etale refinement of a simply-branched balanced Hurwitz chart. Consequently hypothesis (H-S) of FND-0167 at j=8 is FALSE for some allowed S, and any campaign statement that asserts or requires (H-S) while quantifying over 'a reduced locally Noetherian scheme atlas' is false as stated rather than merely unproved. (H-S) must henceforth be attached to a specifically named atlas, or replaced by a stack-level statement, which in turn needs the compact-support mixed-Hodge formalism for Deligne-Mumford stacks that FND-0165 explicitly withholds.
